site.title: Erasmus+ · IC Pescara 6
site.description: Il diario delle mobilità Erasmus+ dell'Istituto Comprensivo Pescara 6: foto, video e testimonianze di studenti e docenti in giro per l'Europa.

mobilities.intro: La prima tappa del nostro viaggio: una settimana in Portogallo tra lezioni, visite e famiglie ospitanti.

testimonials.name: Filippo
testimonials.quote: L’esperienza in Portogallo è stata sicuramente molto significativa. Sono stato ospitato da una famiglia meravigliosa. Ho conosciuto la ragazza che gentilmente mi ha ospitato, Leonor. Un’esperienza Erasmus lascia il segno, perché ti arricchisce tanto. Consiglio a tutti di vivere un’esperienza simile: per me è stata formativa e mi ha fatto crescere tanto.

mobilities.intro: In Grecia, tra i murales e le aule di una scuola che parla di Europa e di cittadinanza.

testimonials.name: Prof.sse Castagna, Trulli, Rinaldi, Panone
testimonials.quote: L’esperienza di Job Shadowing è un viaggio di scoperta e privilegio. Viverlo è l’unico modo per percepire la dirompente connessione che, attraverso i volti incontrati, ci rende consapevoli di far parte di un’unica Europa.

mobilities.intro: Sostenibilità, orti e laboratori all'aperto: una settimana nel cuore verde dell'Irlanda.
Tra palmeti, mare e l'isola di Tabarca: sostenibilità e ambiente con i compagni spagnoli.

testimonials.name: Ilaria
testimonials.quote: The experience of Elche was significant in some aspects: the organization of the very interesting activities, the relationship with the host family and with all the other kids. The best moment for me was the visit to “Tabarca” Island. We all shared fantastic experiences. I discovered their culture and foods that helped me look at reality from a different perspective. It was an unforgettable experience.

testimonials.name: Sofia
testimonials.quote: For my Erasmus experience, I went to Elche, in Spain, where I had the opportunity to live an unforgettable experience with all the Spanish students, the teachers, and the families, and I was able to improve my language skills. These are some of the many opportunities that this project offers. I recommend everyone to try participating in this project because it can help you grow and it gives you wonderful and unforgettable moments. Go Erasmus+!

testimonials.name: Daniele
testimonials.quote: I really enjoyed the Erasmus experience in Elche, especially getting to know Spanish students and their friends. I improved my English a lot and experienced new cultures I had never tried before. I recommend everyone to try an experience like this, even if you’re a bit shy, because gradually you gain confidence with both students and adults. I thank the teachers and the school for giving me the opportunity to live this project.

testimonials.name: Dalila
testimonials.quote: This was my first Erasmus+ project, and it was an enriching experience. I met a lot of kind people and I also visited new places in Spain. We learnt more about sustainability and environment and we improved our English. I recommend everyone to try to participate in the Erasmus+ project.

mobilities.intro: Corsi di formazione per docenti nella capitale irlandese: lingua, metodologie e nuovi colleghi da tutta Europa.

testimonials.name: Prof.ssa Marcucci
testimonials.quote: Apre la mente e lo sguardo a nuove culture, spinge — e allo stesso tempo permette — di rimettersi in gioco anche quando non si è più giovanissimi, aiuta a superare i pregiudizi e spalanca la strada a nuove scoperte.

testimonials.name: Prof.ssa Nada Carota
testimonials.quote: L’Erasmus allunga le prospettive.

testimonials.name: Prof.ssa Castagna
testimonials.quote: Frequentare il corso a Dublino mi ha consentito di riscoprire l’Europa con persuasa consapevolezza, ridestando, tuttavia, nel mio animo la gioia e la curiosità che solo l’esperienza di studio in mobilità Erasmus può donare.

testimonials.name: Prof.ssa Panone
testimonials.quote:
Mai come adesso è necessario… per ricordarci le radici storiche, etiche, sociali dell’Europa:
**E**sperienza
**R**egole
**A**nime
**S**ostenibilità
**M**erito
**U**nione
**S**coperte
… quindi, per i docenti, ancora di più!

mobilities.intro: Formazione docenti a Funchal, tra scogliere sull'Atlantico e mercati colorati.
Andalusia: geologia, cucina, la gita a Guadix e una festa finale che nessuno dimenticherà.

testimonials.name: Vasco
testimonials.quote: In my opinion, the Erasmus project is an excellent project that encourages young people to study while allowing them to discover new cultures beyond their own. I had a lot of fun participating in this project and I perfected my English and Spanish.

testimonials.name: Dalila
testimonials.quote: This was my second Erasmus+ project, and I am so glad I had the opportunity to participate another time. The guys were all super funny and we had a really great time together. The activities we did at the school were very interesting. We learnt so much about the geology of the place. I am looking forward to seeing my new friends in April, here in Italy.

testimonials.name: Marco
testimonials.quote: This experience introduced me to new people, where I bonded and had fun with them. I felt great feelings like happiness, autonomy, and cultural exchange.

testimonials.name: Azzurra
testimonials.quote: For me this experience was beautiful, I didn’t expect it at all and at first I was a little scared before leaving. I found a wonderful family: they welcomed me in a praiseworthy way, I felt right at home. I really liked the organization of the school and how we all spent our afternoons together. I felt strong emotions and beautiful sensations! It left me so nostalgic, because I miss everyone. I would do it a thousand times over again.

testimonials.name: Francesca
testimonials.quote: This Erasmus was my first one. At first, I was really scared, but I forgot everything when we were welcomed with open arms in Benalúa. That place is really great and people are so friendly. The things I liked the most were: the trip to Guadix, the party we had the last night in Benalúa and the cooking activities we experienced at the school. That week really changed my life: now I know Spanish, I have a lot of new friends and beautiful memories. I hope that one day, everyone will have the opportunity and possibility to live an experience like this, because it really opens your mind to things you would have never thought of.

testimonials.name: Prof.ssa Trulli
testimonials.quote: Lots of learning opportunities, a much clearer understanding of the Spanish school system, an inspiring educational environment: these are the features that made the job shadowing experience in IES Benalúa unforgettable and highly valuable regarding the teaching methodology.

mobilities.intro: Job shadowing in una scuola dell'infanzia catalana: inglese, sostenibilità e tanta creatività.

testimonials.name: Ins.te Tiziana Varanese
testimonials.quote: Ho vissuto con grande entusiasmo l’esperienza di visita presso la scuola catalana: il dialogo e il confronto con un contesto educativo diverso hanno rappresentato un importante momento di arricchimento professionale. Tale esperienza conferma l’importanza dell’apertura alla dimensione europea dell’istruzione e l’opportunità che tutti i docenti possano vivere analoghe esperienze formative.

testimonials.name: Ins.te Costantina Lallo
testimonials.quote: L’esperienza di job shadowing a Barcellona presso una scuola dell’infanzia ha offerto un’importante opportunità di crescita professionale. Il confronto con il contesto europeo ha valorizzato l’uso della lingua inglese e l’attenzione alla sostenibilità come elementi centrali della pratica educativa, in linea con gli obiettivi del programma Erasmus+.

mobilities.intro: Ospiti della ScioŠkola Praha Nusle: spazi a misura di bambino e una didattica che nasce dal fare.

testimonials.name: Prof.ssa Lombardi
testimonials.quote: Con gentilezza, spontaneità e curiosità… è così che i ragazzi della ScioŠkola Praha Nusle ci hanno accolte, mostrandoci orgogliosi la loro quotidianità. Ho visto alunni che amano sperimentare affinché il loro fare diventi conoscenza, che hanno spazi a misura per il loro benessere… e mi è piaciuto molto. Un’esperienza formativa e molto interessante.

testimonials.name: Prof.ssa D’Orazio
testimonials.quote: Teaching is my passion, and discovering different perspectives through the Erasmus+ mobilities makes it more and more fascinating.

mobilities.intro: Si torna a Elche: famiglie ospitanti, palmeti, sport a scuola e tante nuove amicizie.

testimonials.name: Andrea
testimonials.quote: Erasmus is an experience that will be imprinted in my memory forever.

testimonials.name: Matteo
testimonials.quote: Hello, my name is Matteo. I participated in the Erasmus project and trust me, it's something that happens once in a lifetime and it must be done. I honestly liked Erasmus a lot, also because it was the first time I slept so far from home. With my classmates we went to Elche, in Spain, and that city is really beautiful; in fact we had a lot of fun, also because the people we met were very nice. We were warmly welcomed by our host families. Therefore it's an experience that I strongly recommend.

testimonials.name: Venere
testimonials.quote: In Erasmus I visited Elche, a beautiful and sunny city. I loved the school organization because they have 8 hours of school, but every half an hour they have a snack and they play football, volleyball, rugby, basketball, tennis and other sports. I loved going for walks with my host family and friends, eating ice cream and going to the shopping centre with friends. I went to a volleyball match with Elena and our host sisters. I loved the warm welcome on our arrival so much. I went to Spain to make new friends, to study Spanish and to improve my English. I also loved the food, the family dinners and staying with the family. I loved the Erasmus+ mobility because I made a lot of new friends.

testimonials.name: Elena P.
testimonials.quote: My Erasmus experience was very nice and exciting. I liked travelling with my classmates and making new friends. We spoke different languages, but we had fun together. I also liked my Spanish family. I learned about their habits and loved Spanish food! Elche is a beautiful city with a lot of palm trees. I really liked visiting it. It was a new and special experience for me and I hope to go on Erasmus again!

testimonials.name: Elena T.
testimonials.quote: Erasmus is an experience that you need to try once in your life. This year I visited Elche, a little city in Spain. My host sister’s name was Julia. With Erasmus you make new friends, visit new places that you have never heard of, and try new food and new experiences. I really hope that with this message I will convince you to try Erasmus at least once in your life, because even if it’s your first time flying without your parents, it is worth it.

testimonials.name: Anna Lucia
testimonials.quote: Hello, my name is Anna Lucia and I participated in the Erasmus+ project. It has been one of the most amazing experiences in my whole life. I felt like a local and had a lot of fun inside and outside the school. Whoever after us is going to experience this wonderful opportunity is going to enjoy it as I enjoyed every second.
